THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

Four allotments of land depicted in the Advance Tracing No.Ma/MNN/2018/159 dated 13.02.2019, prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Village called Thoddaveli in the Grama NiladhariDivision No. MN/62 of Thoddaveli in the Divisional Secretary’sDivision of Mannar Town in Mannar District in Northern Provinceand bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Thoddakani – Extent: 0.1850 HectareNorth: Thoddakani, claimant not known; East: Thoddakani,claimant not known, Thoddakani claimed by Four Teess Rest Innand Lots B and C; South: Lots B, C and D; West: Lot D andThoddakani, claimant not known.
02. Lot ‘B’ – Thoddakani – Extent: 0.4560 HectareNorth: Lot A, Thoddakani, claimant not known and Thoddakaniclaimed by Four Teess Rest Inn; East: Thoddakani claimed by
Four Teess Rest Inn and Road (R.D.A.); South: Road (R.D.A.) andLot C; West: Lots C and A.
03. Lot ‘C’ – Thoddakani – Extent: 0.4560 HectareNorth: Lots A and B; East: Lot B and Road (R.D.A.); South: Road(R.D.A.) and Lot D; West: Lots D and A.

04. Lot ‘D’ – Thoddakani – Extent: 1.1030 HectareNorth: Thoddakani, claimant not known and Lots A and C; East:Lots A and C and Road (R.D.A.); South: Road (R.D.A.) and Road(Pradeshiya Sabha); West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Thoddakani,claimant not known.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/2/2018/CEB/162.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.23rd May, 2019.
